training: Existing synthetic/demo regression fit/train calls only, explicitly authorized; no scientific or product training
official_test177: reserved; audit guard rejects test.jsonl and unsplit pairs.jsonl
incident: The initial aborted regression invoked the pre-existing chunking test which parsed the unsplit corpus before slicing 20 rows. No official model evaluation was performed. Test now uses train only; this is a recorded protocol breach, not claimed pristine isolation.

wording_changes.interpretation: partial/unconfirmed proxy, NOT paraphrase robustness proof

token_convention: P5 scored positions inside kept spans plus mandatory rules. Historical P2/P3/P4 numbers are not recomputed.

benchmark.cold_definition: Fresh process and model initialization; weights already on runner disk; download excluded and reported separately
benchmark.warm_definition: Fresh process performs one short product request before timed full request; no feature cache supplied
benchmark.timeout_reporting: Censored lower bounds, NOT successful timing samples; median/max null if any repetition is censored
benchmark.data: Deterministic repetition of first train context/answer; final string has exactly requested Unicode character count, UTF-8 byte count separately recorded
benchmark.profiling: Separate diagnostic requests only; native benchmark samples have profiler disabled. Python import/process startup is not in seconds; cold bundle/model initialization is included.

ai_share.source: train contexts plus explicitly programmatically generated machine-style blocks; no external generation, fitting or calibration
ai_share.caution: ai_share measures unsupportedness; ai_participation is a separate style estimate. Neither synthetic mixture test certifies real authorship calibration.

release: RC prerelease only, never latest; immutable measured commit; no automatic repository writes
mode_mapping_note: 132/144 are declared whole-corpus mode counts, not train counts (train 92/104). All saved evidence modes are reported, with no selection. Lists clarify the user-requested partial/unconfirmed and missing/oversight grouping; no fitting or metric changes.
